comments: Configuration for VAMS v2.5 to v2.6 OpenSearch reindex migration (vams-*-v2 -> vams-*-v3)
_comment_prefix: Required: SSM resource-name base prefix from CDK core stack output 'ResourceNamesSSMParamPrefixOutput' (format: /{configName}-{baseStackName}/resourceNames). When set, the reindexer function name is resolved automatically from SSM Parameter Store.
_comment_function: Optional override: explicit reindexer Lambda function name (CDK stack output 'ReindexerFunctionNameOutput'). Only needed when the SSM prefix above is not filled in, or to override the SSM-resolved value.
_comment_history: Asset history backfill (phase 2). Table names resolve automatically from the SSM prefix; the explicit overrides below are only needed when the prefix is not set.
_comment_clear: v3 indexes are empty after the v2.6 CDK deploy, so leave clear_indexes=false on first run. Set it to true only when re-running against an already-populated v3 index.
_comment_aws: AWS configuration (optional - override with CLI flags)
_comment_instructions: How to use this configuration file
_instructions: === SETUP ===
1. Get the SSM resource-name base prefix from the CDK core stack outputs:
aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name your-vams-stack \
--query 'Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==`ResourceNamesSSMParamPrefixOutput`].OutputValue' \
--output text
2. Set 'resource_names_ssm_param_prefix' in this file to that value, and set
'aws_region' (and 'aws_profile' if needed). The reindexer Lambda function name
is then resolved automatically from SSM Parameter Store.
Alternative: set 'reindexer_function_name' explicitly (CDK stack output
'ReindexerFunctionNameOutput') to skip or override the SSM lookup.
=== EXECUTION ===
3. Run a dry run first (HIGHLY RECOMMENDED):
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json --dry-run
4. Run the production migration:
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json
5. (Re-run only) Clear the v3 indexes first if a previous run partially populated them:
python v2.5_to_v2.6_migration.py --config v2.5_to_v2.6_migration_config.json --clear-indexes
=== WHAT THIS DOES ===
- Invokes the deployed reindexer Lambda (handlers.indexing.crReindexer)
- Repopulates the new vams-assets-v3 and vams-files-v3 indexes from DynamoDB and S3
- The new geo_MD_location field is automatically derived by the indexer from each entity's metadata
=== OPENSEARCH 3.5 UPGRADE NOTE (PROVISIONED ONLY) ===
If you are running provisioned OpenSearch (config.app.openSearch.useProvisioned.enabled=true) and the
v2.6 CDK deploy of the OpenSearch domain version upgrade (2.7 -> 3.5) fails on an existing domain,
deploy first with config.app.openSearch.useProvisioned.enabled=false to delete the domain, then redeploy
with it re-enabled. The new domain is created on 3.5 and this migration repopulates it from source data.
Serverless deployments are unaffected by the engine upgrade.
=== SAFETY ===
- dry_run: Lambda performs a no-op count pass without writing to OpenSearch
- limit: Caps the number of assets/files processed (testing only)
- clear_indexes: defaults to false; v3 starts empty so the first run never needs it
=== ASSET HISTORY BACKFILL (PHASE 2) ===
- After the reindex, the script backfills the new AssetHistory table from existing asset records:
a 'create' record from each asset's v0 version record (when present), plus 'archive'/'unarchive'
records inferred from the asset's archivedAt/archivedBy and unarchivedAt/unarchivedBy fields.
- Backfilled records are flagged migratedRecord=true and use a deterministic record ID, so re-runs
overwrite rather than duplicate.
- Table names are resolved from the SSM prefix; set the explicit *_table_name overrides only when needed.
- Set skip_asset_history_backfill=true to run the reindex only.
- dry_run and limit apply to this phase as well.
